items.title: The glueing functor is fully faithful on glueable spaces with affine diagonal

items.difficulty_reason: Given a, b agreeing on U', faithfulness of lemma-glueing-f lets one construct f etale-locally on Y ('details omitted', standard locality reduction); for y over V(f) use R/fR = R'/fR' to get the unique y' over y, map it to z' in X' x_X Z, choose an affine etale neighbourhood (W, w), and observe the three fibre products form a triple with affine parts (affine diagonal of Z enters here); lemma-glueing-affines produces the glueable V with the given triple, fully faithfulness for affines gives V -> W and V -> Y, lemma-glueing-affines-etale makes V -> Y etale, and the cartesian point-lifting lemma produces v over y, so f is defined on an etale neighbourhood of every point.
